object: Ворота частокола Ладоги — западные (Чёрный бор), открыты
replaces: the prototype palisade props of the 2 gatepost cells (a = 0 and a = 3 of the footprint) incl. their torches and the lintel/disc drawn by the right gatepost
sort: use the two segment sheets _A / _B, each sorted like a 1×1 palisade cell (scale.md §4.1: long objects in 1–2 tile segments); the full sheet is for previews / static shots

xray.rule: scale.md 1.4 §4.4 / GDD v1.13 §10.3: if the sprite intersects the ellipse rx 56, ry 40 px centred at hero pivot − 22 px and the building sorts IN FRONT of the hero, draw the whole sprite at alpha 0.35 (0.2 s transition); hero gets a 1-px bronze_hi outline when ≥ 25% covered

torch_light: code light r 3 tiles, flame colour, only when open
disc: plain bronze disc on the lintel, unchanged from the prototype (no rosette edits)
